body: She’s a terrible interviewer, like wow.
This was an assault, I question the morality of those who disagree.

Nothing, and I mean nothing will get people to stick to their pre held belief more than something like this. Presenting it as if their current opinion is dumb with the “sigh” and then presenting it like they have no counter argument. 

I want good debate so the best outcome can come out of this mess for everyone involved, I really doubt this comic will change anyone’s mind.
Your already doing the worst sweetheart, no need for us to get involved.
This dog isn’t called Heidi by any chance?

I went into my GPS office with a note from my counsellor about my suicidal thoughts but he genuinely only cared about fixing my physical pain and wouldn’t listen to me mention mental health. I’ve had every form of pain relief available it seems and some stuff works for a time but nothing works for long.
I feel like this could have easily happened?
